tables.name: communication_links
columns: communication_id TEXT NOT NULL FK communications
target_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK closed CommunicationTargetTypeV1
confidence_basis TEXT NOT NULL CHECK in EXACT_IDENTIFIER,EXACT_ALIAS,REVIEWED_MANUAL
direction TEXT NOT NULL CHECK in RECEIVED,SENT,UNKNOWN
effective_chronology_known INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK in 0,1
origin TEXT NOT NULL CHECK in AUTO_SAFE,REVIEWED,MANUAL
state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK in ACTIVE,CLOSED
revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK revision>=1
constraints: only one active semantic link per communication,target_type,target_id

tables.name: communication_link_events
columns: communication_link_id TEXT NOT NULL FK communication_links
event_kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK in CREATED,CORRECTED,CLOSED,RESTORED

tables.name: communication_proposals
columns: communication_id TEXT NOT NULL FK communications
target_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK closed CommunicationTargetTypeV1
state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK in PENDING,DEFERRED,ACCEPTED,REJECTED,SUPERSEDED
revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK revision>=1
constraints: payload_json passes StrictVersionedJson and registered owner proposal schema before insert/update

tables.name: communication_proposal_events
columns: communication_proposal_id TEXT NOT NULL FK communication_proposals
constraints: owner_result_refs_json is null or StrictVersionedJson array of immutable result refs

rules: all known application instants persist as canonical UTC whole seconds
one link correction affects only that link and never rewrites canonical message or sibling links
PENDING/DEFERRED proposals are protected dependencies for retention; ACCEPTED/REJECTED/SUPERSEDED cease proposal hold only after disposition event commits
proposal payload schema authority belongs to the target owner; LLD09 stores validated bytes/fingerprint and disposition history only
